description: This PHP class defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) named PartialJobSpecificationAttachment, representing an attachment related to a partial job specification, including properties such as id, filename, file type, file size, and job title ID.

classes.name: PartialJobSpecificationAttachment
classes.description: A DTO representing an attachment for a partial job specification, encapsulating relevant file and job identifiers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing all properties of the DTO with nullable types.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Returns the associated job title ID.
